camel_example: aliyun btripopen POST /department/v1/department --region cn-hangzhou --header "x-acs-btrip-so-corp-token=feth****ls" --header "Content-Type=application/x-www-form-urlencoded" --body 'depart_list=[{depart_id=1, depart_pid=1, third_depart_id=third_dept_0001, manager_ids=user_0001|user_0002|user_0003, depart_name=产品研发部, third_depart_pid=third_dept_001, status=0}]' --version 2022-05-20 --force
description_en: Synchronizes department information for a specified enterprise in Alibaba Business Travel. This operation is no longer maintained. For new integrations, use the operations for creating, updating, and deleting enterprise departments to manage department information
description_zh: 本接口已不再维护，新接入企业请使用创建企业部门、修改企业部门信息、删除企业部门三个接口进行部门信息的维护。通过调用本接口可以实现新增、维护、删除阿里商旅指定企业下的部门信息
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen department-save --depart-list '[{"depart_id":1,"depart_pid":1,"third_depart_id":"third_dept_0001","manager_ids":"user_0001|user_0002|user_0003","depart_name":"产品研发部","third_depart_pid":"third_dept_001","status":0}]' --x-acs-btrip-so-corp-token 'feth****ls' --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DepartmentSave
